subject: bscf
title: BSCF.------EXT.F.------INFO.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 126 (ALT(FT)II-20). BSCF (basic science) is the subject; EXT-F (extended functionalism) is the partner, and the title names a third code, INFO-DY, whose line starts at the partner's dot. From the subject: TECH-DY (technological dynamics), MT-INFO (multi-information) and ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From TECH-DY: ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism). From MT-INFO: a line to a dot with no label. From ALT-FT: DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture’s center). From EXT-F: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: C-RH (composite research).
